templates.title: Tech Minimalist
templates.description: Clean, modern tech vibe with a focus on core value proposition. Perfect for software developers and tech startups.
templates.prompt: Minimalist technology background, abstract circuit patterns, deep blue and teal neon glow, dark sleek cybernetic aesthetic, high tech, futuristic, 8k resolution

templates.title: Corporate Trust
templates.description: Professional and stable look for financial experts. Conveys trust, reliability, and expertise.
templates.prompt: Modern architectural glass building facade, corporate skyscraper, financial district abstract, blue sky reflection, professional, trustworthy, clean lines, high quality photorealism

templates.title: Creative Portfolio

templates.title: Modern Healthcare
